text:
emma: AcmeInc POC stuck. Azure AD is sending NameID as 'unspecified' and our SCIM shows groups with members as [{"value": null}]. They want Dedicated pool next week for load tests. Can we triage?
gonzalo: 'unspecified' often means IdP is sending a different subject. Ask for full assertion. Also check SAML NameID NameQualifier/Format.
emma: Assertion fragment (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:unspecified">user-abc</saml:NameID>
```
priya: On SCIM, sample they sent:
```json
{"Resources":[{"displayName":"eng-team","members":[{"value":null,"display":null}]}]}
```
priya: Azure SCIM sometimes sends member refs as objects with 'value' pointing to user id. If null, provisioning wasn't allowed by Graph API - check admin consent and delegated permissions.
sec-approvals: Security: Temp Hosted API keys ok for POC if TTL<=72h and ACLs set. Must add audit export and note in questionnaire. No exceptions for production.
infra-sched: Dedicated pool estimate 3 business days post-ticket and VPC peering. If they need immediate concurrency, we can bump hosted limits for 48h while networking is arranged.
bot-provision: [notice] Temporary API key created: poc-acmeinc-temp-48h (expires in 48h). Owner: emma.
gonzalo: Also ask whether they use Azure 'scoped permissions' for the provisioning app. If token lacks Group.Read.All or Directory.Read.All, members can come back empty or null.
emma: I'll request: 1) full SAML assertion, 2) Azure provisioning logs and app permission screenshot, 3) firewall egress rules if they use IP allowlists. I'll share the temp key and Dedicated ETA.
priya: Quick workaround for POC: we can map null member.value to fallback lookup by email claim in assertion if present, but only as a temporary patch (engineering approval needed).
sec-approvals: I'll append the temp key details to the security questionnaire and flag that production SSO requires persistent email NameID or stable id, MFA, and verified SCIM member objects.
emma: Thanks all. I'll update when I have logs back from customer. :thumbsup:
